in_marathi.name: Ishvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's will, wish or desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Ish' (God) and 'Vansh' (lineage, descent, or generation). This name signifies the divine will or the wish of the gods. It is believed that a child named Ishvansh is born with the blessings of the gods and is destined for great things.
